assessment: Independent assessment of every assigned duty; mask arm labels when feasible. Model-assisted assessments and disputes are disclosed separately. Expectation text never enters provider requests.

gates.correct_agreed_findings_and_meanings_req: all 96 trials, including rejected or incomplete outputs
gates.benefit_required: Paired benefit on observed development defects; two perfect arms or different wording alone do not establish improvement.
gates.qualification: Reserved Q1-Q3 may not guide tuning. If used for tuning, move them to development and choose fresh qualification cards before any qualification claim.

historical: Old fifteen-source-review assignment and 30-call scores remain development evidence with their original failed rubrics; this panel neither relabels nor reruns them.
